title: LobbyManager
description: LobbyManager is a lightweight lobby and spawn management plugin for 1.21.x servers. It lets you create multiple lobbies, set a main spawn, teleport players with simple commands, and manage everything through an easy in-game GUI.
body:
# LobbyManager

LobbyManager is a modern, lightweight, and powerful lobby management plugin for Minecraft servers running Paper or Spigot. Designed for both small communities and large server networks, it gives server owners an easy way to manage spawn points, multiple lobbies, teleport menus, and player navigation — all from a clean in-game interface.

Unlike basic spawn plugins that only provide a simple `/spawn` command, LobbyManager delivers a complete lobby system with customizable lobby selectors, intuitive admin tools, configurable messages, and flexible storage support. Whether you need a single central hub or a fully organized multi-lobby setup, LobbyManager+ keeps everything simple, fast, and easy to manage.

Players can quickly return to the main spawn using `/spawn`, or browse available lobbies through `/lobby` with a clean GUI-based selector. Server staff can fully manage lobbies directly in-game without touching configuration files.

---

# Features

- Lightweight and optimized for Paper & Spigot
- Create and manage multiple lobbies
- Main spawn system with `/spawn`
- Lobby selector GUI with teleport support
- Teleport directly using `/lobby <lobby-id>`
- Easy in-game admin management tools
- Custom lobby display names and icons
- Toggle lobby visibility from the admin GUI
- Rename lobbies without editing configs
- Delete lobbies directly in-game
- Configurable messages and settings
- Supports both SQLite and MySQL
- Suitable for survival servers, hubs, and large networks

---

# Commands

## Player Commands

- `/spawn` — Teleport to the main spawn
- `/lobby` — Open the lobby selector GUI
- `/lobby <lobby-id>` — Teleport directly to a specific lobby

## Admin Commands

- `/lm admin` — Open the admin management GUI
- `/lm setspawn` — Set the main spawn location
- `/lm reload` — Reload plugin configuration and storage
- `/lm info` — View plugin information and status

---

# Admin GUI Features

The built-in admin GUI allows staff to manage lobbies entirely in-game:

- Create new lobbies
- Rename lobby IDs
- Change lobby display names
- Edit lobby icons
- Toggle lobby visibility
- Delete lobbies instantly
- Manage lobby settings without restarting the server

---

LobbyManager focuses on simplicity, performance, and ease of use while still giving server owners the flexibility needed for professional-quality lobby systems.
